note: ADD11 (real, id 2407): USE container 120 (exec/truncate, exec/wc) BEFORE stopping it — the correct, common order. Must NOT flag. Contradiction NONE; single context so multi-action NONE.
text:
## Fix

Run these commands one at a time, in order:

1. Empty the Caddyfile:
```bash
pct exec 120 -- truncate -s 0 /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
```
2. Confirm it is now 0 bytes:
```bash
pct exec 120 -- wc -c /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
```
3. Stop the container:
```bash
pct stop 120
```
4. Confirm it is stopped:
```bash
pct status 120
```
